card.name: Digits inside ISBN and ISSN numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit early or in the middle of an ISBN, ISSN, or similar reference number in a citation. It also fires on a digit inside a volume number or postal code.

modes.label: ISBN/ISSN digits
modes.description: A digit partway through a book or journal identifier number in a citation.

modes.label: Other citation numbers
modes.description: A digit inside a journal volume number or a ZIP code.

card.plain: It lights up on the digits inside catalogue numbers like ISBN and ISSN in reference lists.
